name: Analytics Dashboard
description: A calm store dashboard: KPI cards that drive a morphing SVG area chart with crosshair, 7/30/90-day ranges, channel bars and an orders table that turns into cards.

props.name: days
props.description: Daily { date, revenue, orders, sessions }, oldest first. Supply twice the longest range so every KPI has a previous period to compare with.

props.name: defaultMetric
props.description: KPI the main chart shows first. Clicking a KPI card switches it.

props.name: channels
props.description: Revenue share per channel for each range (0–1). Amounts are derived from the period's revenue.

props.name: orders
props.description: Recent orders: id, customer, items, channel, status (Paid | Fulfilled | Pending | Refunded), total, placed.

props.name: nav
props.type: { label: string; icon: DashboardNavIcon; href: string; badge?: string; active?: boolean }[]
props.description: Sidebar links. Icons are keys: overview, orders, products, customers, analytics, marketing, settings.

props.name: payout
props.type: { label: string; amount: string; note: string }
props.description: The payout card pinned to the bottom of the sidebar.

props.name: storeName
props.description: Workspace name in the sidebar and mobile top bar.

props.name: storeUrl
props.description: Secondary line under the store name.

props.name: user
props.description: Signed-in person at the foot of the sidebar.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Date and freshness line under the heading.

name: Sticky Scroll Story
description: A scroll-driven feature story on deep navy: a sticky product panel crossfades through four CSS-drawn states as the steps scroll past.
usage:
import { FeatureStickyScroll } from "@/components/design-for-ai/feature-sticky-scroll";

<FeatureStickyScroll
  brand="Ledgerly"
  heading="Bookkeeping that"
  headingItalic="does itself."
/>

props.name: headingItalic
props.description: Muted second clause of the heading.

props.name: steps
props.description: Four steps, each driving one panel state.

props.name: pots
props.description: Set-aside shares for the final state.

name: Kinetic Type Hero
description: A type foundry hero where every letter of a giant word stack gains weight and leans toward the cursor, with a slow wave on touch and a services marquee.

props.name: lines
props.description: The giant stack, one short line each.

name: Product Stack Hero
description: A light SaaS hero whose three CSS-drawn app windows (a calendar, a burndown and a comment thread) tilt toward the pointer in real 3D.
usage:
import { HeroProductStack } from "@/components/design-for-ai/hero-product-stack";

<HeroProductStack
  brand="Northstar"
  headline="Roadmaps your team will actually read."
  strike="actually"
  primary={{ label: "Try it free", href: "/signup" }}
/>

props.name: strike
props.description: Word set in the accent gradient.

props.name: events
props.description: Calendar blocks: day, start, hours, title, tone.

props.name: sprint
props.type: { name; left; status; actual: number[]; total }

name: Delivery Bottom Sheet
description: A draggable React Native bottom sheet with three snap points and rubber-banding, tracking a grocery courier over a hand-drawn street map with a live route.

props.name: items
props.description: Order lines with quantity and price.

name: Assistant Chat
description: A React Native chat with an AI plant-care assistant: grouped bubbles with tails, an animated typing indicator, quick-reply chips and a live composer.

props.name: fallbackReplies
props.description: Canned replies used in order for typed messages.

name: Night Sky Paywall
description: A React Native subscription paywall for a sleep app: a drawn moon over hills, checked benefits, annual and monthly plan cards with a savings tag, and trial copy.

name: Swipe Inbox
description: A React Native inbox whose rows swipe left to archive or delete and right to pin, with snap points, a full-swipe delete and an undo toast.

props.name: items
props.description: Rows: sender, subject, preview, time, unread, pinned.

props.name: undoWindow
props.description: Milliseconds the undo toast stays up.

props.name: hint
props.description: Nudge the first row on mount to teach the gesture.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Fired when a row is deleted; Undo restores it locally.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fired when a row is tapped.

name: Wallet Card Stack
description: A React Native wallet of payment, membership, coffee and transit cards drawn from layered shapes. Tap one to lift it and open its activity.
usage:
import { MobileWalletStack } from "@/components/design-for-ai/native/mobile-wallet-stack";

<MobileWalletStack cards={myCards} onAdd={() => navigation.navigate("AddCard")} />

props.name: cards
props.description: Cards with art style, wordmark, type, details and transactions.

name: Comparison Matrix
description: A full plan comparison table with a sticky price header, collapsible feature groups, tooltips and a teal recommended column that becomes a plan switcher on mobile.
usage:
import { PricingComparisonMatrix } from "@/components/design-for-ai/pricing-comparison-matrix";

<PricingComparisonMatrix
  plans={plans}        // { id, name, price, unit, blurb, cta }[]
  groups={groups}      // { name, features: { name, hint?, values }[] }[]
  recommendedId="team"
/>

props.name: plans
props.description: Plans in column order: id, name, price, unit, blurb, cta.

props.name: groups
props.description: Collapsible feature groups; values are boolean or a string per plan.

props.name: recommendedId
props.description: Plan id that gets the highlighted column.

name: Receipt Pricing
description: Lifetime pricing printed as a thermal receipt on deep green: torn edges, line items, a stamped total, a barcode and ticket tabs that re-print it.

props.name: options
props.description: One receipt per licence: id, tab label and caption, total, licence and order codes, line items, summary rows and a CTA.

props.name: title
props.description: First line of the headline, in the display face.

props.name: titleAccent
props.description: Second line, italic serif in pale mint.

props.name: brand
props.description: Wordmark printed at the top of the receipt.

props.name: stamp
props.description: Red rubber stamp across the total.

props.name: thanks
props.description: Sign-off at the foot of the receipt.

name: Particle Sphere
description: A Three.js sphere of 14,000 shader-lit particles breathing with simplex noise, wrapped in a tilted orbit. Pointer parallax, responsive, offscreen-aware.
usage: import { ThreeParticleSphere } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-particle-sphere";

props.name: colors
props.description: Rim highlight, mid-tone and core colours.

name: Hover Work Index

props.name: projects
props.description: year, client, discipline, href, cover art key and accent colour.

props.name: previewLabel
props.description: Chip label on the floating card.
